generator client {
    provider = "prisma-client"
    output   = "./generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
    provider = "sqlite"
}

enum RoleType {
    STUDENT
    VOLUNTEER
    ADMIN
    HEAD_ADMIN
}

enum SourceFieldType {
    TEXT
    NUMBER
    DATE
    BOOLEAN
    CHOICE
}

enum AuditAction {
    INVENTORY_INTAKE_SESSION_CREATED
    INVENTORY_INTAKE_SESSION_DELETED
    INVENTORY_INTAKE_SESSION_COMPLETED
    VERIFY_CART_APPROVED
    VERIFY_CART_REJECTED
    EMERGENCY_BAG_CREATED
    EMERGENCY_BAG_EDITED
    SOURCE_CREATED
    SOURCE_EDITED
    CATEGORY_CREATED
    CATEGORY_EDITED
    ITEM_CREATED
    ITEM_EDITED
    LOCATION_CREATED
    LOCATION_EDITED
    TUTORIAL_CREATED
    TUTORIAL_EDITED
    USER_ROLE_EDITED
    ANNOUNCEMENT_CREATED
    ANNOUNCEMENT_EDITED
    DASHBOARD_LINKS_EDITED
    OTHER
}

enum AcademicSemester {
    FALL
    SPRING
    SUMMER
}

model User {
    userID      String   @id @map("user_id")
    displayName String   @default("") @map("display_name")
    role        RoleType @map("role")

    userSession            UserSession?
    orders                 Order[]
    queueNotificationsSent QueueNotification[]
    tutorialCompletions    TutorialCompletion[]
    auditLogs              AuditLog[]

    @@map("user")
}

model UserSession {
    userID     String @id @map("user_id")
    publicCode String @unique @map("public_code")
    publicIcon String @map("public_icon")

    user       User        @relation(fields: [userID], references: [userID], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    cart       Cart?
    queueEntry QueueEntry?

    @@map("user_session")
}

model QueueEntry {
    publicCode String   @id @map("public_code")
    joinedAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("joined_at")
    position   Int      @map("position")

    userSession   UserSession         @relation(fields: [publicCode], references: [publicCode], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    notifications QueueNotification[]

    @@map("queue_entry")
}

model QueueNotification {
    queueNotificationID    String    @id @default(cuid()) @map("queue_notification_id")
    publicCode             String    @map("public_code")
    senderUserID           String    @map("sender_user_id")
    message                String    @map("message")
    createdAt              DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
    acknowledgedAt         DateTime? @map("acknowledged_at")
    acknowledgementMessage String?   @map("acknowledgement_message")

    queueEntry QueueEntry @relation(fields: [publicCode], references: [publicCode], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    sender     User       @relation(fields: [senderUserID], references: [userID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@map("queue_notification")
}

model Category {
    categoryID   String  @id @default(cuid()) @map("category_id")
    categoryName String  @unique @map("category_name")
    imgName      String  @map("img_name")
    archived     Boolean @default(false) @map("archived")

    items Item[]

    @@map("category")
}

model Deal {
    itemID        String @id @map("item_id")
    actualCount   Int    @map("actual_count")
    adjustedCount Int    @map("adjusted_count")

    item Item @relation(fields: [itemID], references: [itemID], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@map("deal")
}

model Item {
    itemID     String  @id @default(cuid()) @map("item_id")
    itemName   String  @unique @map("item_name")
    categoryID String  @map("category_id")
    imgName    String  @map("img_name")
    archived   Boolean @default(false) @map("archived")

    category      Category       @relation(fields: [categoryID], references: [categoryID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)
    deal          Deal?
    specificItems SpecificItem[]

    @@map("item")
}

model ItemLabel {
    itemLabelID   String @id @default(cuid()) @map("item_label_id")
    itemLabelName String @unique @map("item_label_name")

    specificItems SpecificItem[]

    @@map("item_label")
}

model SpecificItem {
    specificItemID String @id @default(cuid()) @map("specific_item_id")
    productName    String @map("product_name")
    quantity       String @map("quantity")
    itemID         String @map("item_id")

    item                                 Item                                  @relation(fields: [itemID], references: [itemID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)
    itemLabels                           ItemLabel[]
    cartItems                            CartItem[]
    orderItems                           OrderItem[]
    emergencyBagItems                    EmergencyBagItem[]
    issuedEmergencyBagItems              IssuedEmergencyBagItem[]
    inventoryIntakeSessionItemChanges    InventoryIntakeSessionItemChange[]
    completedInventoryIntakeSessionItems CompletedInventoryIntakeSessionItem[]

    @@map("specific_item")
}

model Source {
    sourceID   String  @id @default(cuid()) @map("source_id")
    sourceName String  @unique @map("source_name")
    archived   Boolean @default(false) @map("archived")

    fields                           Field[]
    inventoryIntakeSessions          InventoryIntakeSession[]
    completedInventoryIntakeSessions CompletedInventoryIntakeSession[]

    @@map("source")
}

model Field {
    fieldID   String          @id @default(cuid()) @map("field_id")
    fieldName String          @map("field_name")
    sourceID  String          @map("source_id")
    type      SourceFieldType @default(TEXT) @map("type")
    choices   Json?           @map("choices")
    optional  Boolean         @default(false) @map("optional")

    source Source @relation(fields: [sourceID], references: [sourceID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@map("field")
}

model InventoryIntakeSession {
    inventoryIntakeSessionID   String   @id @default(cuid()) @map("inventory_intake_session_id")
    inventoryIntakeSessionName String   @map("inventory_intake_session_name")
    notes                      String   @default("") @map("notes")
    intakeDate                 DateTime @map("intake_date")
    sourceID                   String   @map("source_id")
    sourceName                 String   @map("source_name")
    sourceMetadata             Json?    @map("source_metadata")

    source                            Source                             @relation(fields: [sourceID], references: [sourceID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)
    inventoryIntakeSessionItemChanges InventoryIntakeSessionItemChange[]

    @@map("inventory_intake_session")
}

model InventoryIntakeSessionItemChange {
    inventoryIntakeSessionID String @map("inventory_intake_session_id")
    specificItemID           String @map("specific_item_id")
    amountChanged            Int    @map("amount_changed")

    inventoryIntakeSession InventoryIntakeSession @relation(fields: [inventoryIntakeSessionID], references: [inventoryIntakeSessionID], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    specificItem           SpecificItem           @relation(fields: [specificItemID], references: [specificItemID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@id(name: "inventoryIntakeSessionItemChangeID", [inventoryIntakeSessionID, specificItemID])
    @@map("inventory_intake_session_item_change")
}

model Cart {
    publicCode String   @id @map("public_code")
    createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
    pending    Boolean  @default(false) @map("pending")

    userSession UserSession @relation(fields: [publicCode], references: [publicCode], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    cartItems   CartItem[]

    @@map("cart")
}

model CartItem {
    publicCode      String @map("public_code")
    specificItemID  String @map("specific_item_id")
    count           Int    @map("count")
    countAdjustment Int    @default(0) @map("count_adjustment")

    cart         Cart         @relation(fields: [publicCode], references: [publicCode], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    specificItem SpecificItem @relation(fields: [specificItemID], references: [specificItemID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@id(name: "cartItemID", [specificItemID, publicCode])
    @@map("cart_item")
}

model Location {
    locationID   String  @id @default(cuid()) @map("location_id")
    locationName String  @unique @map("location_name")
    description  String  @map("description")
    archived     Boolean @default(false) @map("archived")
    imgName      String  @map("img_name")
    mapEmbedUrl  String? @map("map_embed_url")

    emergencyBags       EmergencyBag[]
    issuedEmergencyBags IssuedEmergencyBag[]

    @@map("location")
}

model EmergencyBagLabel {
    emergencyBagLabelID   String @id @default(cuid()) @map("emergency_bag_label_id")
    emergencyBagLabelName String @unique @map("emergency_bag_label_name")

    emergencyBags       EmergencyBag[]
    issuedEmergencyBags IssuedEmergencyBag[]

    @@map("emergency_bag_label")
}

model EmergencyBag {
    emergencyBagID String   @id @default(cuid()) @map("emergency_bag_id")
    locationID     String?  @map("location_id")
    private        Boolean  @default(false) @map("private")
    bagDescription String   @default("") @map("bag_description")
    expiryDate     DateTime @map("expiry_date")
    label          String   @unique @map("label")

    location           Location?           @relation(fields: [locationID], references: [locationID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)
    emergencyBagLabels EmergencyBagLabel[]
    emergencyBagItems  EmergencyBagItem[]

    @@map("emergency_bag")
}

model EmergencyBagItem {
    emergencyBagID String @map("emergency_bag_id")
    specificItemID String @map("specific_item_id")
    count          Int    @map("count")

    emergencyBag EmergencyBag @relation(fields: [emergencyBagID], references: [emergencyBagID], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    specificItem SpecificItem @relation(fields: [specificItemID], references: [specificItemID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@id(name: "emergencyBagItemID", [specificItemID, emergencyBagID])
    @@map("emergency_bag_item")
}

model TutorialGroup {
    tutorialGroupID   String @id @default(cuid()) @map("tutorial_group_id")
    tutorialGroupName String @unique @map("tutorial_group_name")

    tutorials Tutorial[]

    @@map("tutorial_group")
}

model Tutorial {
    tutorialID      String @id @default(cuid()) @map("tutorial_id")
    tutorialName    String @map("tutorial_name")
    tutorialGroupID String @map("tutorial_group_id")

    tutorialGroup TutorialGroup        @relation(fields: [tutorialGroupID], references: [tutorialGroupID], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    tutorialSteps TutorialStep[]
    completions   TutorialCompletion[]

    @@map("tutorial")
}

model TutorialStep {
    tutorialStepID String @id @default(cuid()) @map("tutorial_step_id")
    imageUrl       String @map("image_url")
    description    String @map("description")
    stepOrdering   Int    @map("step_ordering")
    tutorialID     String @map("tutorial_id")

    tutorial Tutorial @relation(fields: [tutorialID], references: [tutorialID], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@map("tutorial_step")
}

model TutorialCompletion {
    userID     String   @map("user_id")
    tutorialID String   @map("tutorial_id")
    lastSeenAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("last_seen_at")

    user     User     @relation(fields: [userID], references: [userID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)
    tutorial Tutorial @relation(fields: [tutorialID], references: [tutorialID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@id(name: "tutorialCompletionID", [userID, tutorialID])
    @@map("tutorial_completion")
}

model Announcement {
    announcementID String   @id @default(cuid()) @map("announcement_id")
    message        String   @map("message")
    startsAt       DateTime @map("starts_at")
    endsAt         DateTime @map("ends_at")

    @@map("announcement")
}

model DashboardLink {
    dashboardLinkID   String   @id @default(cuid()) @map("dashboard_link_id")
    displayName       String   @map("display_name")
    url               String   @map("url")
    description       String   @default("") @map("description")
    dashboardRolePage RoleType @map("dashboard_role_page")
    displayOrder      Int      @default(0) @map("display_order")

    @@map("dashboard_link")
}

model AuditLog {
    auditLogID String      @id @default(cuid()) @map("audit_log_id")
    timestamp  DateTime    @default(now()) @map("timestamp")
    action     AuditAction @map("action")
    message    String      @map("message")
    userID     String?     @map("user_id")

    user User? @relation(fields: [userID], references: [userID], onDelete: SetNull, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@map("audit_log")
}

// ********** HISTORICAL TABLES **********

model CompletedInventoryIntakeSession {
    completedInventoryIntakeSessionID String   @id @default(cuid()) @map("completed_inventory_intake_session_id")
    inventoryIntakeSessionName        String   @map("inventory_intake_session_name")
    intakeDate                        DateTime @map("intake_date")
    completedAt                       DateTime @default(now()) @map("completed_at")
    notes                             String   @default("") @map("notes")
    sourceID                          String   @map("source_id")
    sourceName                        String   @map("source_name")
    sourceMetadata                    Json?    @map("source_metadata")

    source                               Source                                @relation(fields: [sourceID], references: [sourceID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)
    completedInventoryIntakeSessionItems CompletedInventoryIntakeSessionItem[]

    @@map("completed_inventory_intake_session")
}

model CompletedInventoryIntakeSessionItem {
    completedInventoryIntakeSessionID String @map("completed_inventory_intake_session_id")
    specificItemID                    String @map("specific_item_id")
    amountChanged                     Int    @map("amount_changed")

    completedInventoryIntakeSession CompletedInventoryIntakeSession @relation(fields: [completedInventoryIntakeSessionID], references: [completedInventoryIntakeSessionID], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    specificItem                    SpecificItem                    @relation(fields: [specificItemID], references: [specificItemID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@id(name: "completedInventoryIntakeSessionItemID", [completedInventoryIntakeSessionID, specificItemID])
    @@map("completed_inventory_intake_session_item")
}

model Order {
    orderID       String   @id @default(cuid()) @map("order_id")
    userID        String   @map("user_id")
    cartCreatedAt DateTime @map("cart_created_at")
    createdAt     DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

    user       User        @relation(fields: [userID], references: [userID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)
    orderItems OrderItem[]

    @@map("order")
}

model OrderItem {
    orderID        String @map("order_id")
    specificItemID String @map("specific_item_id")
    count          Int    @map("count")

    order        Order        @relation(fields: [orderID], references: [orderID], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    specificItem SpecificItem @relation(fields: [specificItemID], references: [specificItemID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@id(name: "orderItemID", [specificItemID, orderID])
    @@map("order_item")
}

model IssuedEmergencyBag {
    issuedEmergencyBagID String   @id @default(cuid()) @map("issued_emergency_bag_id")
    locationID           String?  @map("location_id")
    private              Boolean  @map("private")
    bagDescription       String   @default("") @map("bag_description")
    expiryDate           DateTime @map("expiry_date")
    label                String   @map("label")
    issuedAt             DateTime @default(now()) @map("issued_at")

    location                 Location?                @relation(fields: [locationID], references: [locationID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)
    issuedEmergencyBagLabels EmergencyBagLabel[]
    issuedEmergencyBagItems  IssuedEmergencyBagItem[]

    @@map("issued_emergency_bag")
}

model IssuedEmergencyBagItem {
    issuedEmergencyBagID String @map("issued_emergency_bag_id")
    specificItemID       String @map("specific_item_id")
    count                Int    @map("count")

    issuedEmergencyBag IssuedEmergencyBag @relation(fields: [issuedEmergencyBagID], references: [issuedEmergencyBagID], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: Cascade)
    specificItem       SpecificItem       @relation(fields: [specificItemID], references: [specificItemID], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Cascade)

    @@id(name: "issuedEmergencyBagItemID", [specificItemID, issuedEmergencyBagID])
    @@map("issued_emergency_bag_item")
}
